description: Returns what a SEO Records product does, its platforms, its prices and its secure Stripe payment links (the user pays on Stripe). Products: seo-records-corrector (fixes SEO at serve time, WordPress/PrestaShop/Joomla/Drupal/PHP, from €199/year), seo-autopilot (writes descriptions, FAQs and internal links from real catalog data, PrestaShop, from €199/year), duo (both modules, from €339/year), seo-outpost (the corrector at the network edge, any hosting, from €199 for a year), geo-seo-records (opens and measures the AI assistants channel, from €490 for a year), effect-seo-records (monthly whole-site crawl and difference over a year, from €149 for a year); all returns every product. Docs: https://seorecords.com/assistants
